guard: focus-mode cotal_inbox preserves unreplayable bodies exactly once, keeps exact ingest-time replay promises across policy revocation, and exposes no public replay-off history bypass
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/connector-core build && pnpm smoke:focus-recall-loss
why: The suite drives a real isolated JetStream broker, the actual MeshAgent receive path, endpoint channel policy, and the public cotal_inbox tool. It covers static replay-off, wildcard-only subscriptions, replay true-to-false during one focus episode, before/after-flip non-duplication, destructive pull, and an ordinary core caller attempting to forge a grant.

The grant is exact-message and endpoint-minted: a WeakMap binds one opaque token to one delivered channel/id and a WeakSet records only tokens authorized while replay was true. A random public object therefore cannot bypass replay=false. The connector keeps those exact grants only for the active focus episode.
Every command rebuilds core and connector-core so the mutations reach the dist imports the suite executes.

mutations.cell: replay-off policy is authoritative at ingest
mutations.name: authorize every delivered concrete body
mutations.expectRed: post-flip local bodies must not duplicate through recall

mutations.cell: wildcard-only subscription cannot mint a concrete recall grant
mutations.name: ignore the explicit concrete join requirement
mutations.expectRed: wildcard body must be returned or loss reported

mutations.cell: ingest-time replay promise survives a later policy revoke
mutations.name: drop exact grants before recall
mutations.expectRed: policy-flip bodies must all be returned

mutations.cell: opaque exact-message grants cannot become a public history bypass
mutations.name: trust arbitrary caller-supplied grant objects
mutations.expectRed: public recall token must not bypass replay policy

mutations.cell: post-flip locally retained bodies do not duplicate through historical recall
mutations.name: omit receive-time focus exclusion
mutations.expectRed: post-flip local bodies must not duplicate through recall
